from collections import Counter
s='''5 5 5 5 5 6 5 5 9 5 5 3 0 5 5
5 5 0 6 5 5 5 9 5 3 5 5 5 0 0
0 5 0 6 5 6 5 9 5 5 3 3 5 5 5
9 9 9 3 5 5 9 9 9 5 5 0 5 5 5

5 6 5 5 0 5 9 9 5 3 5 3 5 0 0
5 6 5 5 5 5 5 5 5 3 5 3 0 0 0
6 5 5 0 0 5 9 9 5 3 5 3 0 0 0
5 5 5 0 5 0 6 6 6 0 0 0 5 5 0
3 5 3 5 5 0 6 6 5 5 0 0 5 5 5
3 3 5 5 5 5 6 6 6 5 0 5 5 5 0
0 0 0 0 5 5 5 5 5 0 0 0 5 5 5
5 0 0 5 5 0 5 0 0 0 0 0 6 6 5
0 0 0 5 5 5 5 5 5 0 5 0 5 5 5'''
a=[list(map(int,l.split())) for l in s.splitlines()]
out=[]
for r in range(0,15,3):
 row=[]
 for c in range(0,15,3):
  vals=[a[i][j] for i in range(r,r+3) for j in range(c,c+3) if a[i][j]!=5]
  counts=Counter(vals)
  row.append(counts.most_common())
 out.append(row)
print(out)
print([[x[0][0] if x else 0 for x in row] for row in out])
